question: What are the contents of package sent by John Zoidfarb?
statements: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "people" AS SELECT "zhanghao" AS "zhanghao", "xingming" AS "xingming" FROM table_1;

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "shipments" AS SELECT "shipment" AS "shipment", "baozhuanghao" AS "baozhuanghao", "contents" AS "contents", "weight" AS "weight", "fasongren" AS "fasongren", "shouhuoren" AS "shouhuoren" FROM table_2;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE "employees" AS SELECT "employeeid" AS "employeeid", "name" AS "name", "position" AS "position", "salary" AS "salary", "remarks" AS "remarks" FROM table_3;
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE people AS SELECT CAST(zhanghao AS BIGINT) AS zhanghao, CAST(xingming AS VARCHAR) AS xingming FROM people

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE shipments AS SELECT CAST(shipment AS BIGINT) AS shipment, CAST(baozhuanghao AS BIGINT) AS baozhuanghao, CAST(contents AS VARCHAR) AS contents, CAST(weight AS DOUBLE) AS weight, CAST(fasongren AS BIGINT) AS fasongren, CAST(shouhuoren AS BIGINT) AS shouhuoren FROM shipments

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE employees AS SELECT CAST(employeeid AS BIGINT) AS employeeid, CAST(name AS VARCHAR) AS name, CAST(position AS VARCHAR) AS position, CAST(salary AS DOUBLE) AS salary, CAST(remarks AS VARCHAR) AS remarks FROM employees

CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE conductor_s_execution AS
WITH sender AS (
  SELECT zhanghao AS sender_id
  FROM people
  WHERE LOWER(xingming) = 'john zoidfarb'
)
SELECT s.shipment AS shipment_id,
       s.baozhuanghao AS package_id,
       s.contents,
       s.weight
FROM shipments s
JOIN sender se ON s.fasongren = se.sender_id
ORDER BY s.shipment
LIMIT 10
